subtopics.title: International Cooperation and Financial Links
subtopics.summary: India's external cooperation in the May 2026 round includes SEEDS, a Ministry of External Affairs initiative that supports small and medium enterprises in the Global South. The booklet also covers a labour-rights complaint route under ILO Article 24 and a revised RBI and ECB memorandum on banking supervision. The Eurozone entry explains the euro area's membership, its 1998 founding and its central bank.
facts: SEEDS stands for Supply of Equipment for Efficient Development of SMEs and is implemented by the Ministry of External Affairs.
SEEDS is an Indian developmental cooperation initiative aimed at supporting SMEs in Global South countries.
Subrahmanyam Jaishankar inaugurated India-supported SEEDS projects in Trinidad and Tobago.
Tea plantation workers in West Bengal invoked ILO Article 24, alleging labour rights violations in tea estates.
Article 24 is a formal mechanism through which industrial associations of workers or employers can complain against a member country that fails to implement a ratified ILO Convention.
The Tea Act 1953 established the Tea Board to regulate cultivation, production, sale and export of Indian tea.
The RBI and the ECB signed a revised MoU to enhance cooperation in banking supervision and financial regulation.
The Eurozone is a group of EU countries that use the euro as their official currency and has 21 member countries.
The Eurozone was established in 1998 under the Maastricht Treaty; recent additions are Croatia (2023) and Bulgaria (2026).
The ECB is headquartered in Frankfurt and is collectively owned by the national central banks of all 27 EU member states.

subtopics.title: Defence and Border Infrastructure
subtopics.summary: The Kalam & Kavach 3.0 conference in New Delhi discussed India's defence transformation and military modernisation. DRDO and the Indian Air Force tested the TARA weapon system, which turns an unguided warhead into a precision-guided weapon. The Border Roads Organisation, established in 1960, builds infrastructure in high-altitude and strategically sensitive border areas.
facts: Kalam & Kavach 3.0 was the 3rd edition of the defence conference, held in New Delhi and organised by the Ministry of Defence.
The conference is a high-level platform for India's defence transformation, military modernisation and future preparedness.
JAI stands for Jointness, Aatmanirbharta and Innovation.
TARA stands for Tactical Advanced Range Augmentation.
DRDO and the Indian Air Force conducted the maiden flight trial of the TARA weapon system.
TARA is an indigenous glide weapon system.
Its modular range-extension kit attaches to an existing unguided warhead to convert it into a precision-guided weapon.
The Border Roads Organisation was established in 1960 and is India's premier agency for border infrastructure.
BRO works in high-altitude, remote and strategically sensitive areas and has its headquarters in New Delhi.
BRO's Project Deepak (1961) operates in the Western Himalayas.

subtopics.title: Environment, Wildlife and Weather
subtopics.summary: Human-elephant conflict is addressed through Project Elephant (1992), the Haathi Mere Saathi campaign and Project RE-HAB, which uses bees to deter elephants. Jharkhand is set to establish a dedicated Human-Elephant Conflict Research Centre at Palamu Tiger Reserve. Mission Mausam's urban testbed and aerosol observatory in Chennai tracks urban weather, air quality and aerosols.
facts: Jharkhand is set to establish India's dedicated Human-Elephant Conflict Research Centre at Palamu Tiger Reserve.
Project Elephant was launched in 1992 by the Government of India to protect elephants and conserve their habitats and corridors.
The Haathi Mere Saathi campaign promotes coexistence between humans and elephants.
Retaliatory violence is to be reduced through public awareness, community sensitisation and conservation education.
Project RE-HAB stands for Reducing Elephant-Human Attacks using Bees and is implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission.
The Ministry of Earth Sciences inaugurated an Urban Testbed and Aerosol Observatory under Mission Mausam.
The Urban Testbed and Aerosol Observatory was set up by the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology in Chennai.
The Integrated Atmospheric Monitoring System is designed for real-time urban weather observation, air quality monitoring, aerosol tracking and climate-related research.

subtopics.title: Governance, Crime Data and Remembrance
subtopics.summary: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, with the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies, launched a National AI Skilling Initiative for the creative sector, developed with Google and YouTube. The National Crime Records Bureau, set up in 1986 under the Ministry of Home Affairs, released Crime in India 2024, which covers offences under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita alongside the IPC. A statue of Veera Pasi was unveiled in Raebareli to recognise the heroes of the 1857 revolt.
facts: The National AI Skilling Initiative for the Creative Sector aims to build industry-ready AI capabilities in India's creative industries.
The initiative aims to strengthen India's creative economy and digital content ecosystem.
Target sectors are Media, Animation, Gaming, Digital Storytelling and Content Creation.
The initiative is developed in partnership with Google and YouTube and implemented by the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies.
The NCRB was established in 1986 and acts as India's central repository of crime and criminal data.
The NCRB functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs and its recommendations were based on the Tandon Committee and the National Police Commission.
The NCRB's Crime in India 2024 report includes offences registered under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita alongside the IPC.
Veera Pasi was a warrior of the Pasi community of Uttar Pradesh who served as a commander under Rana Beni Madhav Baksh Singh.
Veera Pasi is remembered as a Dalit freedom fighter who took part in the Revolt of 1857 against British colonial rule.

quizzes.title: Global Cooperation Check
quizzes.passage:
India's external engagement now reaches small businesses abroad, labour rights at home and the working of central banks. Subrahmanyam Jaishankar inaugurated India-supported projects in Trinidad and Tobago under an initiative that supplies equipment to small and medium enterprises in countries of the Global South. The programme is an Indian developmental cooperation initiative, so its benefits flow to partner countries. The projects are part of a wider effort by India to share development resources with friendly nations.

Labour standards also came into focus when tea plantation workers in West Bengal raised allegations of violations in tea estates. The allegations concern conditions inside the tea estates themselves. Their complaint was taken to an international body that holds member countries accountable for implementing ratified conventions. Tea itself is governed by a national board that regulates cultivation, production, sale and export.

On the financial side, the Reserve Bank of India and the European Central Bank have revised a memorandum of understanding, which means an earlier arrangement between them has now been updated. The aim is to enhance cooperation in banking supervision and financial regulation. The euro area is a group of European Union countries that use the euro as their official currency, and its central bank sits at the centre of this cooperation. Over the years, the euro area has expanded as more countries adopted the currency, and additions have come in different years.

questions.q: Which ministry implements the SEEDS initiative?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that SEEDS is implemented by the Ministry of External Affairs.

questions.q: In which year did Bulgaria join the Eurozone as a recent addition?
questions.explanation: The booklet lists Bulgaria as a recent addition in 2026, while Croatia joined in 2023.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Tea Board   ->   A. Headquartered in Frankfurt
II. European Central Bank   ->   B. Created under the Tea Act 1953
III. Eurozone   ->   C. Implemented by the Ministry of External Affairs
IV. SEEDS   ->   D. 21 member countries
questions.explanation: The Tea Act 1953 created the Tea Board, the ECB is headquartered in Frankfurt, the Eurozone has 21 members and SEEDS is run by the Ministry of External Affairs.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The European Central Bank is headquartered in Frankfurt.
Reason (R): The European Central Bank is collectively owned by the national central banks of all 27 EU member states.
Choose the correct option.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: The booklet gives Frankfurt as the ECB's headquarters and separately states its ownership by national central banks, so R does not explain A.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. Industrial associations of workers or employers' organisations can file a complaint against a member country under Article 24.
II. Croatia and Bulgaria joined the Eurozone in the same year.
III. The Eurozone was established under the Maastricht Treaty.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement I matches the Article 24 mechanism and statement III matches the 1998 Maastricht Treaty entry, while Croatia joined in 2023 and Bulgaria in 2026.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements are correct?
I. The SEEDS initiative supports small and medium enterprises in Global South countries.
II. The RBI and the ECB have signed a revised MoU on banking supervision.
III. The Tea Board was established by a 1960 Act.
IV. The Eurozone has 27 member countries.
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are correct, while the Tea Board came from the Tea Act 1953 and the Eurozone has 21 members.

questions.q: Tea plantation workers in West Bengal invoked Article 24 of the constitution of which international body?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that Article 24 belongs to the constitution of the International Labour Organization.

questions.q: In which year was the Eurozone established under the Maastricht Treaty?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the Eurozone was established in 1998 under the Maastricht Treaty.

quizzes.title: Environment and Weather Check
quizzes.passage:
Human-elephant conflict is a serious concern for communities living near elephant habitats, and it affects both people and the animals. Retaliatory violence is one of its most harmful forms, and the response combines several measures that work on the ground and in research. The central government runs a national programme that protects elephants, conserves their habitats and maintains the corridors they use to move. A state has now decided to create a dedicated research centre on this conflict, so that field data and local solutions can be studied in one place.

Other measures focus on people and their livelihoods. Public awareness drives, community sensitisation and conservation education are meant to reduce retaliatory violence. One method uses bees to keep elephants away from crops, and it is run by a national body that supports village industries. A separate public campaign encourages coexistence between humans and elephants.

Weather and air also need careful observation in cities. Under Mission Mausam, an urban testbed and aerosol observatory has been inaugurated in a city. Its work is linked with a Chennai-based research institute. The facility observes urban weather in real time, tracks air quality and aerosols, and supports climate-related research. The facility works in an urban setting, where weather and air observation are tracked in one system.

questions.q: Which tiger reserve will host India's dedicated Human-Elephant Conflict Research Centre? (name of reserve)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the research centre will be set up at Palamu Tiger Reserve in Jharkhand.

questions.q: In which year was Project Elephant launched by the Government of India? (year)
questions.explanation: The booklet gives 1992 as the launch year of Project Elephant.

questions.q: Which campaign promotes coexistence between humans and elephants? (name of campaign)
questions.explanation: The booklet names the Haathi Mere Saathi campaign as the one that promotes coexistence between humans and elephants.

questions.q: Which body implements Project RE-HAB? (short form)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that Project RE-HAB is implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission.

questions.q: Which ministry inaugurated India's Urban Testbed and Aerosol Observatory under Mission Mausam? (ministry name)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the Ministry of Earth Sciences inaugurated the testbed under Mission Mausam.

questions.q: Which Chennai-based institute is named in the booklet's entry on the Urban Testbed and Aerosol Observatory? (short form)
questions.explanation: The booklet names the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology in Chennai in its entry on the testbed.

questions.q: Which state is set to establish India's dedicated Human-Elephant Conflict Research Centre? (name of state)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that Jharkhand is set to establish the dedicated research centre at Palamu Tiger Reserve.
